items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: She should remember, because she used to make me sing all them old Creole songs. When I was small, I knew all them songs. My mother used to learn them to me, you know, Creole songs. And I used to say she'd play them on the piano.

ctx.x: Well, how old would you be, Hal, when you first picked up your... I'm not taking lessons around nine, ten years old. With the T.O.?
